name: @viewportable/slice
description: Viewportable Engine - deterministic responsive QA for coding agents

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --vitest-plugin src test scripts apps tsdown.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --vitest-plugin src test scripts apps tsdown.config.ts
scripts.test:unit: vitest run test/boundary.test.ts test/detector.test.ts test/overflow.test.ts test/fixed-collision.test.ts test/fixed-occlusion.test.ts test/grouping.test.ts test/rows.test.ts test/intervals.test.ts test/containment.test.ts test/node-match.test.ts test/structural-diff.test.ts test/structural-ranges.test.ts test/structural-findings.test.ts test/structural-boundaries.test.ts test/element-protrusion.test.ts test/small-range-overlap.test.ts test/wrapping.test.ts test/diagnose.test.ts test/selector.test.ts test/suppress.test.ts test/demo-server.test.mjs test/github-summary.test.mjs test/github-pr-comment.test.mjs test/github-check-run.test.mjs test/github-app.test.mjs test/agent-evidence-contract.test.ts test/agent-evidence-v2.test.ts test/agent-evidence-v3.test.ts test/agent-evidence-v4.test.ts test/css-source-map.test.ts test/mcp-runner.test.ts test/redecheck-oracle.test.mjs
scripts.check:fast: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run validate:package && npm run validate:release:current
scripts.lab: npm run check:fast && npm run test:integration && npm run smoke
scripts.demo:scan: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.mjs http://127.0.0.1:4173/broken.html --widths 320,390,430,742,743,744,768,1024 --out .slice/demo-manual
scripts.benchmark:redecheck: npm run benchmark:redecheck:prepare && npm run build --silent && node scripts/redecheck-benchmark.mjs
